Third party code vendored into this tool. Nothing is fetched from anyone else at run time.

pdf-lib 1.17.1 — MIT — https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib
  vendor/pdf-lib.min.js
  Reads and writes the PDF. Every page operation in this tool is pdf-lib.
  Licence: static/PDF-LIB-LICENSE.txt

pdf.js 3.11.174 — Apache License 2.0 — Mozilla — https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
  vendor/pdf.min.js and static/pdf.worker.min.js
  Renders the page thumbnails only. It never writes a file.
  Licence: static/PDFJS-LICENSE.txt

Both are unmodified copies of the same files already vendored for the Sign a PDF tool.

Checksums of the files as vendored:
  pdf-lib.min.js  sha256 0f9a5cad07941f0826586c94e089d89b918c46e5c17cf2d5a3c6f666e3bc694f
  pdf.min.js  sha256 5b5799e6f8c680663207ac5b42ee14eed2a406fa7af48f50c154f0c0b1566946
  pdf.worker.min.js  sha256 feabdf309770ed24bba31a5467836cdc8cf639c705af27d52b585b041bb8527b
